fields.description: Issue dated April 7, 1928 (Vol. 6, No. 11) featuring editorials and local political commentary on Miami and Dade County, including discussion of an emerging underworld tied to gambling, liquor, wire-tapping, and graft; warnings about political candidates and corruption; and updates on recall petitions targeting city officials (Sewell, Platt, and Knight). Includes coverage of organized labor politics and claims about attempts to sell the labor vote, notes on the Chamber of Commerce’s new quarters, an Easter-themed editorial, brief local news flashes, and a report that Southern Bank & Trust Company will reopen. Contains candidate-related commentary and numerous local advertisements and entertainment listings.
